top_story_headline: LlamaRisk expands its risk management mandate across the full Aave protocol fleet
top_story_comment: LlamaRisk expanding across Aave v3, v4, and Horizon is the professionalization of DeFi risk management that the space needed three exploit cycles ago. With $4.8B TVL and top 10 wallets controlling 32% of supplied assets, the concentration risk alone justifies a dedicated risk team across the entire protocol fleet. The interesting dynamic: Aave is simultaneously the largest lending protocol and the most governance-heavy. Having LlamaRisk embedded as a persistent risk function — not a one-time audit shop — means governance proposals now have a professional counterweight. This is how protocols scale past the "move fast and break things" phase into institutional-grade infrastructure. The $6.2M monthly revenue makes this a rounding error to fund but potentially existential to skip.
